health_probe.prompt: Connectivity probe only. Do not use tools or read files. Reply exactly: OK

tmux_interactive.snapshot: tmux capture-pane works idle and busy; binding is session_id + session_name

status_line.note: status words are labels only; they are not the idle/working signal

steps: gate: pane is inside a known agent TUI (codex process, cursor chrome, or other declared agents)
if not in an agent: unknown, never idle
if in agent and spinner present or successive frames change: working
if in agent and no change: idle
tui_markers_observed: three footer markers at 33% each; >50% (two or more) confirms Cursor TUI: Cursor <model>, Run Everything, path · branch
pane_title is chat name after first turn, not a status word
observation_rule.spinner_location: TUI status line braille cells, not pane_title
observation_rule.idle_signal: in TUI and successive captures do not change

layers: tool execution: --yolo (else MCP tool call is denied even if server loaded)
